title: Run After Copying the Suffix
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $y,\mathrm{pre},x,u$ be binary words, and suppose $y=\mathrm{pre}\,u$. Starting in loader state $3$ with physical input head at position $|\mathrm{pre}|+1$, input buffer holding $x$ with its head at $|x|$, and empty choice buffer with its head at $0$, after $|u|+(1+(|x|+1)+(|u|+1))+(|u|+1)$ steps the machine has halted and its output is the single bit indicating whether running $N$ on $x$ under choice word $u$ halts with output the one-bit word $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic machine over the binary alphabet
replaced: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine and let the physical input decompose as $y = p\,u$. Starting in the suffix-copy state at position $|p|+1$ with input buffer $x$ and empty choice buffer, after $|u| + (1 + (|x|+1) + (|u|+1)) + (|u|+1)$ steps the pair-loader machine has halted, and its output is the single bit recording whether the run of $N$ on $x$ under choice word $u$ has halted with output the one-bit string $1$.
